rootCauseOneLine: bb stores and serves pasted HEIC bytes verbatim as a localImage (content-type image/heic) and renders the URL in a plain ; Chromium (web + Electron) has no HEIC decoder and bb never transcodes, so the thumbnail/timeline image is broken — and the provider (Codex) cannot process the image either.
proposedFix: Transcode HEIC/HEIF once at the server upload boundary in storeAttachment (apps/server/src/services/projects/attachments.ts): detect image/heic|heif (or .heic/.heif extension), decode with a WASM libheif package (heic-decode/heic-convert; sharp's prebuilt libvips lacks HEIC), store JPEG (PNG if alpha), return mimeType image/jpeg + new path/sizeBytes, enforce the 10MB limit on output, 400 on decode failure. No wire/protocol change needed. Also render an "unsupported image" tile on onError in AttachmentPreview/ConversationAttachments. Regression test = the repro vitest (upload real HEIC -> served type must be Chromium-decodable).
caveats: Repro run on Linux headless Chromium 145 (same Blink decoders as Electron); macOS Safari would likely render HEIC natively (not tested, no Apple hardware). Claude Code Read-tool behavior with HEIC inferred from code, not run. Worktree was initially at origin/main a108fa7ef; I checked out 16ceb3a54 before the live repro and confirmed the relevant files are identical between the two. Repro test file left uncommitted in the worktree at apps/server/test/public/repro-1670-heic-attachment.test.ts.
